#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
#
# The course's Assignment 6 wrapper, changed in four places for this folder:
#   - The project is game/ (the 2D game, from Assignment 2), so it runs
#     --path game; the course's version runs --path godot. Assignment 6 builds
#     in the 2D game only, so this folder holds no other project.
#   - A .tscn test runs as the scene, as the game's checks.tscn always has (its
#     script extends Node, so --script cannot run it); a .gd test still runs
#     with --script. The log is named after the file without its extension.
#   - Godot is $GODOT if set, else godot on PATH, else the macOS app's binary.
#   - It runs from this folder wherever it is called from, so the project path
#     resolves and the logs land in its logs/.
# Unchanged from the course: the realtime mode (no --fixed-fps, for tests that
# wait on audio), the optional timeout (120 s by default; status 124 means the
# test hung), the log name logs/<test>_<fps>fps.log or logs/<test>_realtime.log,
# and failing on any SHADER ERROR or SCRIPT ERROR line, because exit code 0
# does not mean no errors.
set -o pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
if [ $# -lt 2 ] || [ $# -gt 3 ] || [ ! -f "game/tests/$1" ]; then
	echo "usage: scripts/run-test.sh <test-file in game/tests/> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]" >&2
	exit 2
fi
godot=${GODOT:-$(command -v godot || echo /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot)}
if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
	fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
else
	fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
fi
if [[ $1 == *.tscn ]]; then
	run_args=("res://tests/$1")
else
	run_args=(--script "res://tests/$1")
fi
mkdir -p logs
log="logs/$(basename "${1%.*}")_${tag}.log"
timeout "${3:-120}" "$godot" --headless "${fps_args[@]}" --path game "${run_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
status=$?
if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR" "$log"; then status=1; fi
exit $status

2	extends Node2D
3	## Starts the presentation effects from the game's state (CHANGE-BRIEF.md).
4	## It only reads game state, and it only places, mirrors, starts and frees the
5	## effects: their settings live in their scene files.
6	##
7	## Effect A, the sword-swing sparks: each tick that Rudy's sword hitbox goes
8	## from disabled to live, a new SlashSparks burst starts at the hitbox, facing
9	## his way. Every cut gets its own burst, so a fast second cut leaves the first
10	## one running (rule A3), and each burst frees itself once its sparks finish.
11	## It sits after Rudy in Main, so it sees the edge on the tick _swing() makes it.
12	##
13	## Effect B, the running dust trail: RunDust sits in DustTrail, before Rudy in
14	## Main so it draws behind him, and this driver keeps it at his soles every tick.
15	## It emits while he runs on the ground under control and the emitter is visible
16	## in the tree (rules B1, B2, B4). While the tree is paused this driver does not
17	## run, so emitting keeps its value (B3).
18	
19	const SLASH_SPARKS := preload("res://effects/slash_sparks.tscn")
20	const RUN_DUST_OFFSET := Vector2(0, -4)
21	
22	var _box_was_disabled: bool
23	
24	@onready var _rudy: Rudy = get_node("../Rudy")
25	@onready var _sword_box: CollisionShape2D = _rudy.get_node("SwordHitbox/Shape")
26	@onready var _slash_bursts: Node2D = $SlashBursts
27	@onready var _run_dust: GPUParticles2D = get_node("../DustTrail/RunDust")
28	
29	
30	func _ready() -> void:
31		_box_was_disabled = _sword_box.disabled # so a load never fires a burst
32	
33	
34	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
35		var disabled := _sword_box.disabled
36		if _box_was_disabled and not disabled:
37			_fire_slash_sparks()
38		_box_was_disabled = disabled
39		_drive_run_dust()
40	
41	
42	func _fire_slash_sparks() -> void:
43		var burst: Node2D = SLASH_SPARKS.instantiate() # a new burst per cut: overlap (A3)
44		_slash_bursts.add_child(burst)
45		burst.global_position = _sword_box.global_position
46		burst.scale.x = _rudy.facing
47		(burst.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).finished.connect(burst.queue_free)
48		for emitter: GPUParticles2D in burst.get_children():
49			emitter.emitting = true
50	
51	
52	func _drive_run_dust() -> void:
53		# It follows him even when idle, so a respawn's jump lays down nothing (B5).
54		_run_dust.global_position = _rudy.global_position + RUN_DUST_OFFSET
55		var running := _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and _rudy.is_on_floor() \
56				and absf(_rudy.velocity.x) > 1.0
57		var want := running and _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree() # hidden: no unseen puffs (B4)
58		if _run_dust.emitting != want:
59			_run_dust.emitting = want

2	## Headless state checks for Effect A, the sword-swing sparks (CHANGE-BRIEF.md,
3	## section 2, rules A1–A5). Run from this folder:
4	##   scripts/run-test.sh test_slash_sparks_state.tscn 60
5	## It plays Main through the real game loop: every cut comes from the slash
6	## action, the sword from walking into the pickup, the pause from the pause
7	## action. It never calls the driver. The only game state it writes is Rudy's
8	## place, as checks.gd's _teleport does, to put him next to the pickup, a
9	## goblin or open ground.
10	## A recorder reads, each physics tick, the sword hitbox's disabled flag and
11	## every burst the driver adds to Effects/SlashBursts. This node runs before
12	## Main's nodes in each tick, so what it reads is the state at the end of the
13	## tick before: an edge it sees on tick N happened on tick N - 1.
14	## Headless, the dummy renderer draws nothing and runs no particle process, so
15	## these checks read node state only (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
16	## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.
17	
18	const MAIN := preload("res://app/main.tscn")
19	
20	
21	## One burst as the recorder saw it.
22	class Burst:
23		var node: Node2D
24		var born := -1 ## the tick the driver added it
25		var exited := -1 ## the tick it left the tree
26		var in_container := false ## its parent is Effects/SlashBursts, and no Rudy or goblin is its ancestor
27		var sampled := false
28		# Read on the tick after its birth, before anything else moves:
29		var pos: Vector2
30		var shape_pos: Vector2
31		var x_axis_x := 0.0 ## global_transform.x.x: its mirror sign
32		var facing := 0
33		var others: Array[Dictionary] = [] ## every other live burst then: node, pos, emitting
34	
35	
36	var _failures := 0
37	var _main: Main
38	var _rudy: Rudy
39	var _box: CollisionShape2D
40	var _slash_bursts: Node2D
41	var _tick := 0
42	var _was_disabled := true
43	var _edges: Array[int] = [] ## ticks on which the hitbox went from disabled to live
44	var _bursts: Array[Burst] = []
45	var _max_alive := 0
46	
47	
48	func _ready() -> void:
49		await _run_load()
50		await _run_play()
51		print("all checks passed" if _failures == 0 else "%d check(s) FAILED" % _failures)
52		get_tree().quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)
53	
54	
55	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
56		if not is_instance_valid(_rudy):
57			return
58		_tick += 1
59		var disabled := _box.disabled
60		if _was_disabled and not disabled:
61			_edges.append(_tick - 1)
62		_was_disabled = disabled
63		for b in _bursts:
64			if not b.sampled and is_instance_valid(b.node) and b.node.is_inside_tree():
65				b.sampled = true
66				b.pos = b.node.global_position
67				b.shape_pos = _box.global_position
68				b.x_axis_x = b.node.global_transform.x.x
69				b.facing = _rudy.facing
70				for other in _bursts:
71					if other != b and is_instance_valid(other.node) and other.node.is_inside_tree():
72						b.others.append({
73							"node": other.node,
74							"pos": other.node.global_position,
75							"emitting": (other.node.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).emitting,
76						})
77		_max_alive = maxi(_max_alive, _alive())
78	
79	
80	## A fresh level; without `with_title` it skips the title and starts in play.
81	func _start_level(with_title := false) -> void:
82		Main.title_shown = not with_title
83		_main = MAIN.instantiate()
84		add_child(_main)
85		_rudy = _main.get_node("Rudy")
86		_box = _rudy.get_node("SwordHitbox/Shape")
87		_slash_bursts = _main.get_node("Effects/SlashBursts")
88		_slash_bursts.child_entered_tree.connect(_on_burst_entered)
89		_was_disabled = _box.disabled
90	
91	
92	func _on_burst_entered(node: Node) -> void:
93		var b := Burst.new()
94		b.node = node
95		b.born = _tick
96		var ancestor_is_game := _rudy.is_ancestor_of(node)
97		for goblin in _main.get_node("Level1/Enemies").get_children():
98			ancestor_is_game = ancestor_is_game or goblin.is_ancestor_of(node)
99		b.in_container = node.get_parent() == _slash_bursts and not ancestor_is_game
100		node.tree_exited.connect(func() -> void: b.exited = _tick)
101		_bursts.append(b)
102	
103	
104	## S1, S2: nothing fires on load or on the title.
105	func _run_load() -> void:
106		_start_level(true)
107		await _frames(60)
108		await _tap(&"slash")
109		await _frames(30)
110		_check("S1 on load and on the title, with slash pressed there: no burst",
111			_bursts.is_empty() and _main.state == Main.State.TITLE,
112			"bursts %d, state %s" % [_bursts.size(), Main.State.keys()[_main.state]])
113		_main.queue_free()
114		await _frames(1)
115	
116		_start_level()
117		await _frames(60)
118		_check("S2 on load with the title skipped, after 60 ticks: no burst", _bursts.is_empty(),
119			"bursts %d" % _bursts.size())
120	
121	
122	func _run_play() -> void:
123		var level: Node2D = _main.get_node("Level1")
124		var pickup: SwordPickup = level.get_node("SwordPickup")
125		var goblin_a: Goblin = level.get_node("Enemies/GoblinA")
126		var goblin_b: Goblin = level.get_node("Enemies/GoblinB")
127		var ground_y := (level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position.y
128	
129		# S3: slash without the sword.
130		var n := _bursts.size()
131		var e := _edges.size()
132		await _tap(&"slash")
133		await _frames(30)
134		_check("S3 slash without the sword: no burst, no live edge",
135			_bursts.size() == n and _edges.size() == e and _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.NONE,
136			"bursts %d, edges %d" % [_bursts.size() - n, _edges.size() - e])
137	
138		# The sword, by walking into the pickup.
139		_teleport(Vector2(pickup.global_position.x - 200.0, ground_y))
140		await _frames(2)
141		await _hold_until(&"move_right", func() -> bool: return _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.SWORD, 120)
142		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.is_on_floor() and _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, 60)
143	
144		# S4, S5: one cut facing right.
145		n = _bursts.size()
146		e = _edges.size()
147		await _tap(&"slash")
148		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
149		await _frames(2)
150		var new_bursts := _bursts.slice(n)
151		var new_edges := _edges.slice(e)
152		_check("S4 one cut: exactly one burst, born on the tick the hitbox went live",
153			new_bursts.size() == 1 and new_edges.size() == 1 and new_bursts[0].born == new_edges[0],
154			"bursts born on %s, edges on %s" % [_born_ticks(new_bursts), new_edges])
155		if new_bursts.size() == 1:
156			var b: Burst = new_bursts[0]
157			_check("S5 facing right: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and not mirrored",
158				b.sampled and b.pos.distance_to(b.shape_pos) <= 1.0 and b.x_axis_x > 0.0 and b.facing == 1,
159				"burst %s, hitbox %s, x.x %.2f, facing %d" % [b.pos, b.shape_pos, b.x_axis_x, b.facing])
160		else:
161			_check("S5 facing right: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and not mirrored", false, "no single burst")
162	
163		# S6: turned on the spot, one cut facing left.
164		await _tap(&"move_left")
165		await _frames(2)
166		n = _bursts.size()
167		await _tap(&"slash")
168		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
169		await _frames(2)
170		new_bursts = _bursts.slice(n)
171		if new_bursts.size() == 1:
172			var b: Burst = new_bursts[0]
173			_check("S6 facing left: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and mirrored",
174				b.sampled and b.pos.distance_to(b.shape_pos) <= 1.0 and b.x_axis_x < 0.0 and b.facing == -1,
175				"burst %s, hitbox %s, x.x %.2f, facing %d" % [b.pos, b.shape_pos, b.x_axis_x, b.facing])
176		else:
177			_check("S6 facing left: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and mirrored", false,
178				"%d bursts" % new_bursts.size())
179		await _frames(40)
180	
181		# S7, S8: a second cut right after the first swing ends, inside the first burst's life.
182		n = _bursts.size()
183		e = _edges.size()
184		await _tap(&"slash")
185		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
186		await _tap(&"slash")
187		await _frames(45)
188		new_bursts = _bursts.slice(n)
189		new_edges = _edges.slice(e)
190		if new_bursts.size() == 2 and new_edges.size() == 2:
191			var first: Burst = new_bursts[0]
192			var second: Burst = new_bursts[1]
193			var seen: Dictionary = {}
194			for other in second.others:
195				if other.node == first.node:
196					seen = other
197			_check("S7 two cuts %d ticks apart: two bursts alive at the second cut; the first is the same node, not moved, still emitting"
198					% (new_edges[1] - new_edges[0]),
199				second.born == new_edges[1] and second.others.size() == 1 and not seen.is_empty()
200				and (seen.pos as Vector2).distance_to(first.pos) <= 0.01 and seen.emitting,
201				"alive with the second %d, first seen %s, first at %s then %s, emitting %s"
202				% [second.others.size() + 1, not seen.is_empty(), first.pos, seen.get("pos"), seen.get("emitting")])
203			_check("S8 the first burst leaves the tree 25–30 ticks after its birth: not restarted, not cut short",
204				first.exited - first.born >= 25 and first.exited - first.born <= 30,
205				"born %d, left %d: %d ticks" % [first.born, first.exited, first.exited - first.born])
206		else:
207			_check("S7 two cuts: two bursts alive at the second cut", false,
208				"bursts born on %s, edges on %s" % [_born_ticks(new_bursts), new_edges])
209			var life: int = (new_bursts[0].exited - new_bursts[0].born) if not new_bursts.is_empty() else -1
210			_check("S8 the first burst leaves the tree 25–30 ticks after its birth: not restarted, not cut short",
211				life >= 25 and life <= 30, "%d ticks" % life)
212	
213		# S9: mashing slash for 2 s.
214		n = _bursts.size()
215		e = _edges.size()
216		_max_alive = 0
217		var swings := 0
218		var was_slashing := false
219		for i in 120:
220			if i % 2 == 0:

## Headless state checks for Effect A, the sword-swing sparks (CHANGE-BRIEF.md,
## section 2, rules A1–A5). Run from this folder:
##   scripts/run-test.sh test_slash_sparks_state.tscn 60
## It plays Main through the real game loop: every cut comes from the slash
## action, the sword from walking into the pickup, the pause from the pause
## action. It never calls the driver. The only game state it writes is Rudy's
## place, as checks.gd's _teleport does, to put him next to the pickup, a
## goblin or open ground.
## A recorder reads, each physics tick, the sword hitbox's disabled flag and
## every burst the driver adds to Effects/SlashBursts. This node runs before
## Main's nodes in each tick, so what it reads is the state at the end of the
## tick before: an edge it sees on tick N happened on tick N - 1.
## Headless, the dummy renderer draws nothing and runs no particle process, so
## these checks read node state only (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.

const MAIN := preload("res://app/main.tscn")


## One burst as the recorder saw it.
class Burst:
	var node: Node2D
	var born := -1 ## the tick the driver added it
	var exited := -1 ## the tick it left the tree
	var in_container := false ## its parent is Effects/SlashBursts, and no Rudy or goblin is its ancestor
	var sampled := false
	# Read on the tick after its birth, before anything else moves:
	var pos: Vector2
	var shape_pos: Vector2
	var x_axis_x := 0.0 ## global_transform.x.x: its mirror sign
	var facing := 0
	var others: Array[Dictionary] = [] ## every other live burst then: node, pos, emitting


var _failures := 0
var _main: Main
var _rudy: Rudy
var _box: CollisionShape2D
var _slash_bursts: Node2D
var _tick := 0
var _was_disabled := true
var _edges: Array[int] = [] ## ticks on which the hitbox went from disabled to live
var _bursts: Array[Burst] = []
var _max_alive := 0


func _ready() -> void:
	await _run_load()
	await _run_play()
	print("all checks passed" if _failures == 0 else "%d check(s) FAILED" % _failures)
	get_tree().quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_rudy):
		return
	_tick += 1
	var disabled := _box.disabled
	if _was_disabled and not disabled:
		_edges.append(_tick - 1)
	_was_disabled = disabled
	for b in _bursts:
		if not b.sampled and is_instance_valid(b.node) and b.node.is_inside_tree():
			b.sampled = true
			b.pos = b.node.global_position
			b.shape_pos = _box.global_position
			b.x_axis_x = b.node.global_transform.x.x
			b.facing = _rudy.facing
			for other in _bursts:
				if other != b and is_instance_valid(other.node) and other.node.is_inside_tree():
					b.others.append({
						"node": other.node,
						"pos": other.node.global_position,
						"emitting": (other.node.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).emitting,

	Main.title_shown = not with_title
	_main = MAIN.instantiate()
	add_child(_main)

	_box = _rudy.get_node("SwordHitbox/Shape")
	_slash_bursts = _main.get_node("Effects/SlashBursts")

	_was_disabled = _box.disabled

	var b := Burst.new()
	b.node = node
	b.born = _tick
	var ancestor_is_game := _rudy.is_ancestor_of(node)
	for goblin in _main.get_node("Level1/Enemies").get_children():

	_bursts.append(b)

## states (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, STORYBOARD.md panels 1 and 4–7):
## - TITLE: the game opens on the start of the level with the title on top
##   (UI-TITLE) and Rudy idle, out of the player's control; the hearts are
##   hidden. Enter fades the title out and the hearts in, and play starts on the
##   same screen. The title shows once each time the game starts: Enter on the
##   end card plays again without it;
## - PLAYING;
## - DYING: a fall below a cliff, which costs a heart, or a hit that takes his
##   last heart. After a fade every monster is back where it started, even the
##   defeated ones, and so is the sword-and-shield pickup. After a fall that leaves him hearts, Rudy gets back up at
##   the last checkpoint, the lit waystone or else the start, with the hearts he
##   has left. Once his last heart is gone, by a hit or a fall, the level starts
##   over from the opening: he is at the start with full hearts, and the
##   waystone is dark;
## - COMPLETE: entered once, on the teleport circle. Input stops, Rudy
##   celebrates, the light rises, the camera pulls back, and the screen fades to
##   the end card, where Enter plays the level again from the opening.
## The camera follows Rudy sideways only, so the ground stays at the same height
## on screen and a fall drops him out of the frame. It shakes briefly on a hit.
##
## In play, Esc pauses everything but the music, which drops 12 dB and keeps
## its place, and shows "Paused"; Esc again resumes. Only in play: not on the
## title, through a death and the respawn, or from the teleport circle on.
## SystemKeys reads the key, since this node stops while the game is paused.
##
## The music (Music, CHANGE-BRIEF.md): it starts on the title and plays on when
## Enter starts play; it dips under a hit and through a death and the respawn,
## and never restarts from the top; on the teleport circle it fades out, and
## the end card is silent. A fall plays the hurt sound as he crosses the kill
## line, since it costs a heart.

signal restart_requested ## only when Main is not the current scene, as in the checks

enum State { TITLE, PLAYING, DYING, COMPLETE }

const KILL_Y := 1300.0 ## below this line he has fallen out of the level
const FALL_HOLD := 0.25 ## s after he crosses the kill line, before the fade
const DEFEAT_HOLD := 0.8 ## s in CHAR-DEFEAT before the fade
const FADE_TIME := 0.35 ## s each way
const CELEBRATE_TIME := 2.0 ## s on the circle before the fade to the end card
const END_ZOOM := Vector2(0.8, 0.8)
const ZOOM_TIME := 1.5
const SHAKE_TIME := 0.2 ## s the camera shakes on a hit
const SHAKE_PX := 8.0

static var title_shown := false ## once the title has shown, a restart goes straight to play

var state := State.PLAYING
var checkpoint_name := "start"

var _checkpoint: Vector2
var _end_card_shown := false
var _shake_left := 0.0

@onready var _rudy: Rudy = $Rudy
@onready var _camera: Camera2D = $Camera
@onready var _hud: Hud = $Hud
@onready var _waystone: Waystone = $Level1/Waystone

	_checkpoint = (_level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position

	var right_bound: Node2D = _level.get_node("Bounds/Right")
	_camera.limit_right = roundi(right_bound.global_position.x)
	_snap_camera()
	_waystone.activated.connect(_on_waystone_activated)
	_portal.reached.connect(_on_portal_reached)
	_rudy.hit.connect(_on_rudy_hit)
	_rudy.defeated.connect(_on_rudy_defeated)
	_hud.track(_rudy)
	Music.start()
	if not title_shown:
		state = State.TITLE
		_rudy.mode = Rudy.Mode.WAITING
		_hud.show_title()
	_show_status()

	_camera.position.x = _rudy.global_position.x

		_start_play()

		_end_card_shown = false
		_restart()

func _start_play() -> void:
	title_shown = true
	state = State.PLAYING
	_rudy.mode = Rudy.Mode.PLAY

	_show_status()

## gone, the level starts over from the opening.
func _die(cause: StringName) -> void:
	state = State.DYING # set first, so the kill line ignores him from now on
	var start_over := true # a defeat: his last heart is gone
	if cause == &"fall":
		start_over = _rudy.fall_out() # only if the fall took his last heart
		Sfx.play(&"hurt")
	Music.dip(&"death", Music.DEATH_DIP)
	_show_status()
	await get_tree().create_timer(FALL_HOLD if cause == &"fall" else DEFEAT_HOLD).timeout
	await _hud.fade_to(1.0, FADE_TIME)
	if start_over:
		_back_to_the_opening()
	_rudy.respawn_at(_checkpoint, start_over)
	for monster in _level.get_node("Enemies").get_children():
		monster.reset()
	_pickup.reset() # he gets back up without gear, so the pickup is back where it was
	_shake_left = 0.0
	_camera.offset = Vector2.ZERO
	_snap_camera()
	await _hud.fade_to(0.0, FADE_TIME)
	if _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.RESPAWNING:
		await _rudy.respawned
	state = State.PLAYING
	Music.end_dip(&"death")
	_show_status()

## waystone is dark.
func _back_to_the_opening() -> void:
	_checkpoint = (_level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position
	checkpoint_name = "start"
	_waystone.reset()

func toggle_pause() -> void:
	var tree := get_tree()
	if tree.paused:
		tree.paused = false
		Music.end_dip(&"pause")
		_hud.show_paused(false)
	elif state == State.PLAYING:
		tree.paused = true
		Music.dip(&"pause", Music.PAUSE_DIP)
		_hud.show_paused(true)

func _on_rudy_hit() -> void:
	_shake_left = SHAKE_TIME
	Music.dip(&"hurt", Music.HURT_DIP, Music.HURT_TIME)


func _on_rudy_defeated() -> void:
	if state == State.PLAYING:
		_die(&"defeat")


func _on_waystone_activated(waystone: Waystone) -> void:
	_checkpoint = waystone.spawn_point.global_position
	checkpoint_name = "waystone"
	_show_status()


func _on_portal_reached() -> void:
	if state != State.PLAYING:
		return
	state = State.COMPLETE # entered once; input stops
	_rudy.celebrate()
	Sfx.play(&"portal")
	Music.fade_out()
	_show_status()
	_portal.light_up(CELEBRATE_TIME)

func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if get_tree().paused:
		get_tree().paused = false
		Music.end_dip(&"pause")


func _restart() -> void:
	if get_tree().current_scene == self:
		get_tree().reload_current_scene()
	else:
		restart_requested.emit()


func _snap_camera() -> void:
	_camera.position.x = _rudy.global_position.x
	_camera.reset_smoothing()


func _show_status() -> void:
	_hud.set_status("%s, checkpoint: %s" % [State.keys()[state], checkpoint_name])

## section 3, rules B1–B5). Run from this folder:
##   scripts/run-test.sh test_run_dust_state.tscn 60
## It plays Main through the real game loop: every run, stop, turn, jump, hit
## and pause comes from an input action, and it never calls the driver. Besides
## Main.title_shown, set before load so the title shows, the main sequence
## writes no game state: the only nodes it writes are RunDust's and DustTrail's
## visibility, for rule B4, which are presentation nodes. D14 alone writes
## Rudy's place once, as checks.gd's _teleport does, to put him by a cliff.

## RunDust's state. This node runs before Main's nodes in each tick, so what it
## reads is the state at the end of the tick before, with the condition and
## emitting read at the same moment: a driver a tick late would show as a
## mismatch at every edge. A visibility write is made by the recorder right
## after it reads, so no sample falls between that write and the driver's tick.
## Headless, the dummy renderer draws nothing and runs no particle process, so
## these checks read node state only (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.

const MAIN := preload("res://app/main.tscn")
const OFFSET := Vector2(0, -4) ## the emitter's place relative to Rudy's soles (B2)


## One physics tick as the recorder saw it.
class Sample:
	var tick := 0
	var cond := false ## the brief's condition: in play, on the floor, |velocity.x| > 1
	var emitting := false
	var shown := false ## RunDust.is_visible_in_tree()
	var dust_pos: Vector2
	var rudy_pos: Vector2
	var vx := 0.0
	var on_floor := false
	var mode := 0
	var facing := 0
	var amount := 0
	var ratio := 0.0


var _failures := 0
var _main: Main
var _rudy: Rudy
var _dust_trail: Node2D
var _run_dust: GPUParticles2D
var _tick := 0
var _samples: Array[Sample] = []
var _pending := Callable() ## a write the recorder makes right after it reads


func _ready() -> void:
	await _run()
	print("all checks passed" if _failures == 0 else "%d check(s) FAILED" % _failures)
	get_tree().quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_rudy):
		return
	_tick += 1
	var s := Sample.new()
	s.tick = _tick
	s.vx = _rudy.velocity.x
	s.on_floor = _rudy.is_on_floor()
	s.mode = _rudy.mode
	s.facing = _rudy.facing
	s.cond = s.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and s.on_floor and absf(s.vx) > 1.0
	s.emitting = _run_dust.emitting
	s.shown = _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree()
	s.dust_pos = _run_dust.global_position
	s.rudy_pos = _rudy.global_position
	s.amount = _run_dust.amount
	s.ratio = _run_dust.amount_ratio
	_samples.append(s)
	if _pending.is_valid():
		var write := _pending
		_pending = Callable()
		write.call()


func _run() -> void:
	# D1: on load, with the title showing.
	Main.title_shown = false
	_main = MAIN.instantiate()
	add_child(_main)
	_rudy = _main.get_node("Rudy")
	_dust_trail = _main.get_node("DustTrail")
	_run_dust = _dust_trail.get_node("RunDust")
	Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _samples.size() >= 30, 40)
	Input.action_release(&"move_right")
	var window := _samples.slice(0)
	_check("D1 on load and on the title, move_right held 30 ticks: emitting false every tick",
		window.size() >= 30 and _count(window, "emitting") == 0 and _main.state == Main.State.TITLE
		and _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.WAITING,
		"%d ticks, %d emitting, state %s, mode %s"
		% [window.size(), _count(window, "emitting"), Main.State.keys()[_main.state], Rudy.Mode.keys()[_rudy.mode]])

	# D2: play starts; he stands.
	await _tap(&"restart")
	var i := _samples.size()
	await _frames(30)
	window = _samples.slice(i)
	_check("D2 play started, standing 30 ticks: condition and emitting false every tick",
		window.size() >= 30 and _count(window, "cond") == 0 and _count(window, "emitting") == 0
		and _main.state == Main.State.PLAYING,
		"%d ticks, condition %d, emitting %d, state %s"
		% [window.size(), _count(window, "cond"), _count(window, "emitting"), Main.State.keys()[_main.state]])

	# D3: he starts running right.
	i = _samples.size()
	Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x >= _rudy.run_speed, 30)
	await _frames(5)
	var cond_up := _edges(i, "cond", true)
	var emit_up := _edges(i, "emitting", true)
	_check("D3 move_right held: one rising edge of the condition and one of emitting, on the same tick",
		cond_up.size() == 1 and cond_up == emit_up,
		"condition rose on %s, emitting on %s" % [cond_up, emit_up])

extends SceneTree
## The headless CPU price of the two effects (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, section 8),
## adapted from Chapter 9's examples/09-particle-effects/tests/particle_cost.gd.
## Run from this folder, at a fixed rate:
##   scripts/run-test.sh cost_effects.gd 60 300
## Without --fixed-fps, headless frames sleep toward 6.9 ms and every case reads
## the same (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, failure 13).
##
## It times whole frames, as the chapter's script does, in five cases:
## - empty: an empty Node2D, the chapter's control;
## - game, effects off: Main with Effects and DustTrail removed before it enters
##   the tree, Rudy idle at the start;
## - game, effects off, running: the same, with Rudy running, a control for B;
## - Effect A at its most: Main as it ships, Rudy idle, with 2 SlashSparks
##   bursts alive on every timed frame (rule A3: at most 2 at once). A new burst
##   starts whenever one finishes, the way EffectsDriver starts one, because
##   real swings keep 2 alive for only part of each 0.3 s;
## - Effect B at its most: Main as it ships, Rudy running at full speed on the
##   ground, so RunDust emits on every timed frame and no burst is alive.
## Rudy runs by holding move_right, on the flat stretch x 2050–2350 between
## GoblinA's patrol and the pickup; each time he reaches its end, this script
## moves him back to its start without touching his velocity, as checks.gd's
## _teleport moves him. That is the only game state it writes.
## Each round builds every case afresh and times it, so drift over the run falls
## on every case alike. It reports each case's per-frame mean and spread over
## all rounds, the spread of the round means, and what each case did on its
## timed frames, so a case that did not reach its state shows.
## Headless Godot uses a dummy renderer: no particle is processed or drawn, so
## this measures node bookkeeping and the driver's code, not the effects' GPU
## time (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).

const WARM_UP_FRAMES := 60
const TIMED_FRAMES := 300
const ROUNDS := 5
const MOST_BURSTS := 2 ## rule A3
const BURST_GAP := 10 ## frames at least between two bursts, so they stay staggered
const LAP_START_X := 2050.0
const LAP_END_X := 2350.0
const CASES := ["empty", "game_off", "game_off_running", "effect_a", "effect_b"]
const LABELS := {
	"empty": "Empty scene",
	"game_off": "Game, both effects off, Rudy idle",
	"game_off_running": "Game, both effects off, Rudy running (control for B)",
	"effect_a": "Effect A, 2 bursts alive, Rudy idle",
	"effect_b": "Effect B, Rudy running, emitting",
}


## One case being built and timed.
class Run:
	var name := ""
	var node: Node
	var rudy: CharacterBody2D
	var sword_box: CollisionShape2D
	var slash_bursts: Node2D
	var run_dust: GPUParticles2D
	var running := false
	var bursts := false
	var frame := 0
	var last_burst := -BURST_GAP
	# What it did on its timed frames:
	var started := 0
	var alive_min := 1 << 30
	var alive_max := 0
	var sparks_emitting_min := 1 << 30
	var cond_ticks := 0
	var dust_ticks := 0
	var particle_nodes := 0


var _main_scene: PackedScene
var _sparks_scene: PackedScene
var _times := {} ## case -> every timed frame's ms
var _round_means := {} ## case -> each round's mean ms
var _did := {} ## case -> the last round's Run


func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")


func run() -> void:
	print("Rendering method: ", RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method())
	print("Video adapter: ", RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_name())
	print("Command line: ", " ".join(OS.get_cmdline_args()))
	print("Headless Godot uses a dummy renderer, so GPU particle simulation and all drawing are not measured.")
	print("%d rounds; each case per round: %d warm-up frames, then %d timed frames." % [
		ROUNDS, WARM_UP_FRAMES, TIMED_FRAMES])
	_main_scene = load("res://app/main.tscn")
	_sparks_scene = load("res://effects/slash_sparks.tscn")
	for name in CASES:
		_times[name] = []
		_round_means[name] = []

	for round_index in ROUNDS:
		for name in CASES:
			var r := _build(name)
			for _frame in WARM_UP_FRAMES:
				_step(r, false)
				await process_frame
			var started_usec := Time.get_ticks_usec()
			var last_usec := started_usec
			for _frame in TIMED_FRAMES:
				_step(r, true)
				await process_frame
				var now_usec := Time.get_ticks_usec()
				_times[name].append((now_usec - last_usec) / 1000.0)
				last_usec = now_usec
			_round_means[name].append((last_usec - started_usec) / 1000.0 / TIMED_FRAMES)
			_did[name] = r
			_tear_down(r)
			for _frame in 3:
				await process_frame
		print("round %d of %d done" % [round_index + 1, ROUNDS])

	r.sword_box = r.rudy.get_node("SwordHitbox/Shape")
	if main.has_node("Effects"):
		r.slash_bursts = main.get_node("Effects/SlashBursts")
		r.run_dust = main.get_node("DustTrail/RunDust")
	r.running = name in ["game_off_running", "effect_b"]
	r.bursts = name == "effect_a"
	if r.running:
		r.rudy.global_position.x = LAP_START_X
		Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	return r


## Runs once before each frame, warm-up and timed alike.
func _step(r: Run, timed: bool) -> void:
	r.frame += 1
	if r.running and r.rudy.global_position.x >= LAP_END_X:
		r.rudy.global_position.x = LAP_START_X
	if r.bursts:
		var alive := _alive_bursts(r)
		if alive.size() < MOST_BURSTS and r.frame - r.last_burst >= BURST_GAP:
			_start_burst(r)
			alive = _alive_bursts(r)
			if timed:
				r.started += 1
		if timed:
			var emitting := 0
			for burst in alive:
				if (burst.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).emitting:
					emitting += 1
			r.alive_min = mini(r.alive_min, alive.size())
			r.alive_max = maxi(r.alive_max, alive.size())
			r.sparks_emitting_min = mini(r.sparks_emitting_min, emitting)
	if timed and r.rudy != null:
		if r.rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and r.rudy.is_on_floor() and absf(r.rudy.velocity.x) > 1.0:
			r.cond_ticks += 1
		if r.run_dust != null and r.run_dust.emitting:
			r.dust_ticks += 1
		if r.frame == WARM_UP_FRAMES + 1:
			r.particle_nodes = r.node.find_children("*", "GPUParticles2D", true, false).size()


## As EffectsDriver._fire_slash_sparks starts one: at the hitbox, facing his way.
func _start_burst(r: Run) -> void:
	var burst: Node2D = _sparks_scene.instantiate()
	r.slash_bursts.add_child(burst)
	burst.global_position = r.sword_box.global_position
	burst.scale.x = r.rudy.facing
	(burst.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).finished.connect(burst.queue_free)
	for emitter: GPUParticles2D in burst.get_children():
		emitter.emitting = true
	r.last_burst = r.frame


func _alive_bursts(r: Run) -> Array[Node]:
	return r.slash_bursts.get_children().filter(func(n: Node) -> bool: return not n.is_queued_for_deletion())


func _tear_down(r: Run) -> void:
	if r.running:
		Input.action_release(&"move_right")
	r.node.queue_free()


func _did_line(r: Run) -> String:
	if r.name == "empty":
		return "nothing"
	var line := "%d GPUParticles2D in the tree, condition held %d/%d, RunDust emitting %d/%d" % [
		r.particle_nodes, r.cond_ticks, TIMED_FRAMES, r.dust_ticks, TIMED_FRAMES]
	if r.bursts:
		line += ", bursts alive %d–%d, sparks emitting at least %d, %d bursts started" % [
			r.alive_min, r.alive_max, r.sparks_emitting_min, r.started]
	return line


func _report(name: String) -> void:
	var times: Array = _times[name]
	var sorted := times.duplicate()
	sorted.sort()
	var rounds: Array = _round_means[name]
	print("  %-52s mean %.4f ms, sd %.4f, median %.4f, p95 %.4f, max %.4f; round means %.4f–%.4f ms" % [
		LABELS[name], _mean(times), _sd(times), sorted[sorted.size() / 2],
		sorted[int(sorted.size() * 0.95)], sorted[-1], rounds.min(), rounds.max()])


func _compare(a: String, b: String, should_differ: bool) -> void:
	var diff := _mean(_times[a]) - _mean(_times[b])
	var ra: Array = _round_means[a]
	var rb: Array = _round_means[b]
	var overlap: bool = ra.min() <= rb.max() and rb.min() <= ra.max()
	var verdict := "round-mean ranges overlap: not told apart" if overlap else "round-mean ranges apart"
	if overlap and should_differ:
		verdict += "  WARNING: these should differ; the script may be measuring itself"
	print("  %-18s - %-18s %+.4f ms  (%s)" % [a, b, diff, verdict])


func _mean(values: Array) -> float:
	var total := 0.0
	for v: float in values:
		total += v
	return total / values.size()


func _sd(values: Array) -> float:
	var m := _mean(values)
	var total := 0.0
	for v: float in values:
		total += (v - m) * (v - m)
	return sqrt(total / values.size())

## The headless CPU price of the two effects (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, section 8),
## adapted from Chapter 9's examples/09-particle-effects/tests/particle_cost.gd.
## Run from this folder, at a fixed rate:
##   scripts/run-test.sh cost_effects.gd 60 300
## Without --fixed-fps, headless frames sleep toward 6.9 ms and every case reads
## the same (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, failure 13).
##
## It times whole frames, as the chapter's script does, in five cases:
## - empty: an empty Node2D, the chapter's control;
## - game, effects off: Main with Effects and DustTrail removed before it enters
##   the tree, Rudy idle at the start;
## - game, effects off, running: the same, with Rudy running, a control for B;
## - Effect A at its most: Main as it ships, Rudy idle, with 2 SlashSparks
##   bursts alive on every timed frame (rule A3: at most 2 at once). A new burst
##   starts whenever one finishes, the way EffectsDriver starts one, because
##   real swings keep 2 alive for only part of each 0.3 s;
## - Effect B at its most: Main as it ships, Rudy running at full speed on the
##   ground, so RunDust emits on every timed frame and no burst is alive.
## Rudy runs by holding move_right, on the flat stretch x 2050–2350 between
## GoblinA's patrol and the pickup; each time he reaches its end, this script
## moves him back to its start without touching his velocity, as checks.gd's
## _teleport moves him. That is the only game state it writes.
## Each round builds every case afresh and times it, so drift over the run falls
## on every case alike. It reports each case's per-frame mean and spread over
## all rounds, the spread of the round means, and what each case did on its
## timed frames, so a case that did not reach its state shows.
## Headless Godot uses a dummy renderer: no particle is processed or drawn, so
## this measures node bookkeeping and the driver's code, not the effects' GPU
## time (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).

const WARM_UP_FRAMES := 60
const TIMED_FRAMES := 300
const ROUNDS := 5
const MOST_BURSTS := 2 ## rule A3
const BURST_GAP := 10 ## frames at least between two bursts, so they stay staggered
const LAP_START_X := 2050.0
const LAP_END_X := 2350.0
const CASES := ["empty", "game_off", "game_off_running", "effect_a", "effect_b"]
const LABELS := {
	"empty": "Empty scene",
	"game_off": "Game, both effects off, Rudy idle",
	"game_off_running": "Game, both effects off, Rudy running (control for B)",
	"effect_a": "Effect A, 2 bursts alive, Rudy idle",
	"effect_b": "Effect B, Rudy running, emitting",
}


## One case being built and timed.
class Run:
	var name := ""
	var node: Node
	var rudy: CharacterBody2D
	var sword_box: CollisionShape2D
	var slash_bursts: Node2D
	var run_dust: GPUParticles2D
	var running := false

	var frame := 0
	var last_burst := -BURST_GAP

	var alive_max := 0
	var sparks_emitting_min := 1 << 30
	var cond_ticks := 0
	var dust_ticks := 0
	var particle_nodes := 0


var _main_scene: PackedScene
var _sparks_scene: PackedScene
var _times := {} ## case -> every timed frame's ms
var _round_means := {} ## case -> each round's mean ms
var _did := {} ## case -> the last round's Run


func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")


func run() -> void:
	print("Rendering method: ", RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method())
	print("Video adapter: ", RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_name())
	print("Command line: ", " ".join(OS.get_cmdline_args()))
	print("Headless Godot uses a dummy renderer, so GPU particle simulation and all drawing are not measured.")
	print("%d rounds; each case per round: %d warm-up frames, then %d timed frames." % [
		ROUNDS, WARM_UP_FRAMES, TIMED_FRAMES])
	_main_scene = load("res://app/main.tscn")
	_sparks_scene = load("res://effects/slash_sparks.tscn")
	for name in CASES:
		_times[name] = []
		_round_means[name] = []

	for round_index in ROUNDS:
		for name in CASES:
			var r := _build(name)
			for _frame in WARM_UP_FRAMES:
				_step(r, false)
				await process_frame
			var started_usec := Time.get_ticks_usec()
			var last_usec := started_usec
			for _frame in TIMED_FRAMES:
				_step(r, true)
				await process_frame
				var now_usec := Time.get_ticks_usec()
				_times[name].append((now_usec - last_usec) / 1000.0)
				last_usec = now_usec
			_round_means[name].append((last_usec - started_usec) / 1000.0 / TIMED_FRAMES)
			_did[name] = r
			_tear_down(r)
			for _frame in 3:
				await process_frame
		print("round %d of %d done" % [round_index + 1, ROUNDS])

	print("Per frame, over %d timed frames in %d rounds:" % [ROUNDS * TIMED_FRAMES, ROUNDS])
	for name in CASES:

	print("")
	print("What each case did on its timed frames (last round):")

	print("Differences of the mean, with the round means' ranges:")

	_compare("effect_a", "game_off", false)
	_compare("effect_b", "game_off_running", false)
	_compare("game_off_running", "game_off", false)
	_compare("effect_b", "game_off", false)
	var means: Array[float] = []
	for name in CASES:

func _build(name: String) -> Run:
	var r := Run.new()
	r.name = name
	if name == "empty":
		r.node = Node2D.new()
		root.add_child(r.node)
		return r
	Main.title_shown = true # straight to play, as test_slash_sparks_state.gd's _start_level does
	var main: Node2D = _main_scene.instantiate()
	if name.begins_with("game_off"):
		for path in ["Effects", "DustTrail"]:
			var node := main.get_node(path)
			main.remove_child(node)
			node.free()
	root.add_child(main)
	r.node = main
	r.rudy = main.get_node("Rudy")
	r.sword_box = r.rudy.get_node("SwordHitbox/Shape")
	if main.has_node("Effects"):
		r.slash_bursts = main.get_node("Effects/SlashBursts")
		r.run_dust = main.get_node("DustTrail/RunDust")
	r.running = name in ["game_off_running", "effect_b"]
	r.bursts = name == "effect_a"
	if r.running:
		r.rudy.global_position.x = LAP_START_X
		Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	return r


## Runs once before each frame, warm-up and timed alike.
func _step(r: Run, timed: bool) -> void:
	r.frame += 1
	if r.running and r.rudy.global_position.x >= LAP_END_X:
		r.rudy.global_position.x = LAP_START_X
	if r.bursts:
		var alive := _alive_bursts(r)
		if alive.size() < MOST_BURSTS and r.frame - r.last_burst >= BURST_GAP:
			_start_burst(r)
			alive = _alive_bursts(r)
			if timed:
				r.started += 1
		if timed:
			var emitting := 0
			for burst in alive:
				if (burst.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).emitting:
					emitting += 1
			r.alive_min = mini(r.alive_min, alive.size())
			r.alive_max = maxi(r.alive_max, alive.size())
			r.sparks_emitting_min = mini(r.sparks_emitting_min, emitting)
	if timed and r.rudy != null:
		if r.rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and r.rudy.is_on_floor() and absf(r.rudy.velocity.x) > 1.0:
			r.cond_ticks += 1
		if r.run_dust != null and r.run_dust.emitting:
			r.dust_ticks += 1
		if r.frame == WARM_UP_FRAMES + 1:
			r.particle_nodes = r.node.find_children("*", "GPUParticles2D", true, false).size()


## As EffectsDriver._fire_slash_sparks starts one: at the hitbox, facing his way.
func _start_burst(r: Run) -> void:
	var burst: Node2D = _sparks_scene.instantiate()
	r.slash_bursts.add_child(burst)
	burst.global_position = r.sword_box.global_position
	burst.scale.x = r.rudy.facing
	(burst.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).finished.connect(burst.queue_free)
	for emitter: GPUParticles2D in burst.get_children():
		emitter.emitting = true
	r.last_burst = r.frame


func _alive_bursts(r: Run) -> Array[Node]:
	return r.slash_bursts.get_children().filter(func(n: Node) -> bool: return not n.is_queued_for_deletion())


func _tear_down(r: Run) -> void:
	if r.running:
		Input.action_release(&"move_right")
	r.node.queue_free()


func _did_line(r: Run) -> String:
	if r.name == "empty":
		return "nothing"
	var line := "%d GPUParticles2D in the tree, condition held %d/%d, RunDust emitting %d/%d" % [
		r.particle_nodes, r.cond_ticks, TIMED_FRAMES, r.dust_ticks, TIMED_FRAMES]
	if r.bursts:
		line += ", bursts alive %d–%d, sparks emitting at least %d, %d bursts started" % [
			r.alive_min, r.alive_max, r.sparks_emitting_min, r.started]
	return line


func _report(name: String) -> void:
	var times: Array = _times[name]
	var sorted := times.duplicate()
	sorted.sort()
	var rounds: Array = _round_means[name]
	print("  %-52s mean %.4f ms, sd %.4f, median %.4f, p95 %.4f, max %.4f; round means %.4f–%.4f ms" % [
		LABELS[name], _mean(times), _sd(times), sorted[sorted.size() / 2],
		sorted[int(sorted.size() * 0.95)], sorted[-1], rounds.min(), rounds.max()])


func _compare(a: String, b: String, should_differ: bool) -> void:
	var diff := _mean(_times[a]) - _mean(_times[b])
	var ra: Array = _round_means[a]
	var rb: Array = _round_means[b]
	var overlap: bool = ra.min() <= rb.max() and rb.min() <= ra.max()
	var verdict := "round-mean ranges overlap: not told apart" if overlap else "round-mean ranges apart"
	if overlap and should_differ:
		verdict += "  WARNING: these should differ; the script may be measuring itself"
	print("  %-18s - %-18s %+.4f ms  (%s)" % [a, b, diff, verdict])


func _mean(values: Array) -> float:
	var total := 0.0
	for v: float in values:
		total += v
	return total / values.size()


func _sd(values: Array) -> float:
	var m := _mean(values)
	var total := 0.0
	for v: float in values:
		total += (v - m) * (v - m)
	return sqrt(total / values.size())

I wrote `game/tests/cost_effects.gd` and ran it with `./scripts/run-test.sh cost_effects.gd 60 300`. It finished with no `SCRIPT ERROR` or `SHADER ERROR`, and the log is `logs/cost_effects_60fps.log`. Nothing is committed, and I changed no other file.

## Real output (the measurement lines, copied exactly)

```
Per frame, over 1500 timed frames in 5 rounds:
  Empty scene                                          mean 0.0038 ms, sd 0.0007, median 0.0040, p95 0.0040, max 0.0160; round means 0.0037–0.0039 ms
  Game, both effects off, Rudy idle                    mean 0.0507 ms, sd 0.0115, median 0.0490, p95 0.0690, max 0.2160; round means 0.0474–0.0580 ms
  Game, both effects off, Rudy running (control for B) mean 0.0521 ms, sd 0.0106, median 0.0510, p95 0.0720, max 0.0960; round means 0.0482–0.0601 ms

  Effect B, Rudy running, emitting                     mean 0.0559 ms, sd 0.0117, median 0.0550, p95 0.0780, max 0.1150; round means 0.0502–0.0632 ms

What each case did on its timed frames (last round):
  Game, both effects off, Rudy idle                    0 GPUParticles2D in the tree, condition held 0/300, RunDust emitting 0/300
  Game, both effects off, Rudy running (control for B) 0 GPUParticles2D in the tree, condition held 300/300, RunDust emitting 0/300
  Effect A, 2 bursts alive, Rudy idle                  5 GPUParticles2D in the tree, condition held 0/300, RunDust emitting 0/300, bursts alive 2–2, sparks emitting at least 2, 21 bursts started
  Effect B, Rudy running, emitting                     1 GPUParticles2D in the tree, condition held 300/300, RunDust emitting 300/300

Differences of the mean, with the round means' ranges:
  game_off           - empty              +0.0469 ms  (round-mean ranges apart)
  effect_a           - game_off           +0.0079 ms  (round-mean ranges overlap: not told apart)
  effect_b           - game_off_running   +0.0039 ms  (round-mean ranges overlap: not told apart)
  game_off_running   - game_off           +0.0013 ms  (round-mean ranges overlap: not told apart)
  effect_b           - game_off           +0.0052 ms  (round-mean ranges overlap: not told apart)
```

The log ends with `4 ObjectDB instances were leaked at exit` and `2 resources still in use at exit`. Those don't fail the wrapper, and the existing logs end the same way.

## What the numbers say

- **The script is not just measuring itself.** The empty scene (0.0038 ms) and the game with both effects off (0.051 ms) are far apart. That is about 13 times more, and their per-round averages (round means) don't overlap. The script's own warning, for when every case reads the same, did not fire.
- **Effect A, at 2 bursts alive, costs +0.008 ms; Effect B costs +0.004 ms against the running control.** Both are within the brief's prediction of 0.01 ms. But both differences are smaller than the spread between rounds, so the script can't reliably tell either effect from the game without it. That is what the brief predicts for GPU nodes on the dummy renderer, not a fault in the script. The headless price says nothing about the 0.25 ms GPU budget.
- **The game with effects off read 0.051 ms**, at the bottom of the brief's 0.05–0.5 ms guess. The empty scene read 0.0038 ms, a little above the probe's 0.0028 ms.
- **Each case reached the state it was meant to measure.** Effect A had exactly 2 bursts alive on all 300 timed frames. Effect B was emitting on 300 of 300, and the effects-off cases had no particle node in the tree.

## How the script differs from the chapter's

- **An extra fifth case.** I added "effects off, Rudy running" as a control for Effect B, so B's difference isn't mixed up with the cost of Rudy running. It turned out to cost only +0.001 ms.
- **The script starts Effect A's bursts itself, not real slash presses.** Real swings keep 2 bursts alive for only part of each swing. So, whenever one burst finishes, the script starts a new one the same way `EffectsDriver` does, which keeps 2 alive on every timed frame. The driver's own trigger code still runs every frame.
- **Effect B moves Rudy back to keep him running.** Rudy holds `move_right` on the flat stretch from x 2050 to 2350, and the script moves him back to the start each time he reaches the end, keeping his speed. That moving is the only game state the script writes.
- **"Effects off" means the nodes are removed.** `Effects` and `DustTrail` are taken out of `Main` before it enters the tree. The scene file itself is not touched.
- **It times the cases in rounds.** Each case is rebuilt and timed fresh in each of 5 rounds, so slow drift over the run affects every case alike. The script reports the mean, standard deviation, median, 95th percentile and maximum per frame, plus the range of the round means.
- **It doesn't name the game's classes directly.** A `--script` run compiles the test before the autoloads (`Music`, `Sfx`) exist, so naming `Main` or `Rudy` broke the first run. The script now loads `main.gd` and `rudy.gd` once the game is running instead. One small thing in the log: the "Command line" line shows only `--script …`, because Godot takes `--fixed-fps 60` out before the script can see it. The wrapper did pass it.
